scripts.build: npm run build -w @pocketpilot/shared && npm run build -w @pocketpilot/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pocketpilot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pocketpilot/server && npm run typecheck -w @pocketpilot/app
scripts.lint: eslint app/src server/src server/test shared/src shared/test --max-warnings=0
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pocketpilot/shared && npm run test -w @pocketpilot/server
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @pocketpilot/shared && npm run dev -w @pocketpilot/server
scripts.dev:app: npm run build -w @pocketpilot/shared && npm run start -w @pocketpilot/app
scripts.android: npm run build -w @pocketpilot/shared && npm run android -w @pocketpilot/app
